findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is now an abstract class that cannot be instantiated
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now subclasses StatefulDetectorHandler with an empty body. That base class has abstract members that the subclass does not implement: counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values and the newly added build_occurrence_and_event_data. MetricAlertFire.detector_handler points at this class. Detector.detector_handler calls group_type.detector_handler(self), so any detector of type metric_alert_fire will raise TypeError ("Can't instantiate abstract class") inside process_detectors. Before this change the handler had a stub evaluate that returned [], so this is a regression. Keep the old stub behaviour or implement the abstract methods.

findings.title: evaluate docstring still says it returns a list
findings.body: The signature of StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate now returns dict[DetectorGroupKey, DetectorEvaluationResult], but the docstring still says it "returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`".
